Container.Name: MagicMirror
Container.Overview: MagicMirror² is an open source modular smart mirror platform. It turns a display behind a two-way mirror (or just a browser tab) into a personal dashboard showing clock, calendar, weather, news and hundreds of community modules.[br][br]This template runs MagicMirror² in server-only mode, which is the correct mode for a headless Unraid server: the interface is served over HTTP and rendered by any browser or by a separate client device such as a Raspberry Pi.[br][br][b]IMPORTANT — two one-time steps are required before the first start, otherwise the container will not work:[/b][br][br][b]1. Fix the appdata permissions.[/b] The image runs as UID/GID 1000, but Unraid creates appdata as 99:100. Open the Unraid terminal and run:[br][br]mkdir -p /mnt/user/appdata/magicmirror/config /mnt/user/appdata/magicmirror/modules[br]chown -R 1000:1000 /mnt/user/appdata/magicmirror[br][br]Without this the container logs "No write permission for /opt/magic_mirror/config" and never creates its configuration.[br][br][b]2. Make MagicMirror² reachable on your LAN.[/b] On first start the container writes a default config.js into the config folder. That default only listens on localhost, so the WebUI will refuse your connection. Edit /mnt/user/appdata/magicmirror/config/config.js and set:[br][br]address: "0.0.0.0",[br]ipWhitelist: ["127.0.0.1", "::ffff:127.0.0.1", "::1", "192.168.0.0/16", "172.16.0.0/12", "10.0.0.0/8"],[br][br]Then restart the container. Adjust the whitelist to match your own subnet, or set it to [] to allow every address.[br][br]The container image is built and maintained by Karsten Hassel (https://gitlab.com/khassel/magicmirror). This template only provides the Unraid packaging.

Container.Requires: Two one-time setup steps are required — see the description. The appdata folder must be owned by UID/GID 1000, and config.js must be edited to listen on 0.0.0.0 before the WebUI is reachable.
Container.Changes: ### 2026-08-04[br]- Initial release. Server-only mode, based on karsten13/magicmirror:debian-server.
Container.DefaultTagDescription: debian-server — Debian 13 based, server-only mode. Recommended for Unraid.

Branch.TagDescription: wolfi-server — Wolfi based, smaller image with a reduced CVE surface. Server-only mode.
alpine — Alpine based, smallest image. Server-only mode. Some native modules may not build.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: HTTP port MagicMirror² listens on. Must match the port set in config.js.

Config.Name: Config
Config.Description: Holds config.js and custom.css. Must be owned by UID/GID 1000 — see the description.

Config.Name: Modules
Config.Description: Holds third party modules you install. Must be owned by UID/GID 1000 — see the description.

Config.Name: TZ
Config.Description: Timezone in tz database format, for example Europe/Berlin or America/New_York. If unset the container falls back to UTC.

Config.Name: MM_SCENARIO
Config.Description: Run mode. Leave at 'server' on Unraid — 'electron' needs a local display and will not work on a headless server.

Config.Name: MM_SHOW_CURSOR
Config.Description: Set to 'true' to show the mouse cursor in the interface. Useful when you drive MagicMirror² with a touchscreen.
